tasks.short: Secure an area to be fumigated

steps.what: Post warning signs and lock building doors to secure the fumigation area

tasks.design: Retain physical warning placement and access securing with the worker, using site instructions in {DOCS}. Test native document access if it is separately burdensome; a digital checklist does not replace the physical task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work changes physical access and warning conditions at a particular site.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital instructions support reference but do not secure doors or place signs.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding actual access conditions and recognising incomplete securing.
tasks.human_edge: Physical presence and checking the site against its actual configuration.
tasks.altitude: The worker retains responsibility for this physical site task.

reach.task: Discuss access restrictions affecting site work

evidence.claim: Physical warning placement and access securing remain human work; no local digital labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the worker's warning placement and physical access securing, not treatment planning, fumigation or subsequent release of the area.

Supervisor supplies site and treatment instructions before s1; worker observes actual access and completes physical actions during s1. No machine receives a free cleared-building flag, door-state feed or confirmed warning-placement record.
Existing native document access is the first option if reference retrieval becomes an observed separate problem.
No new software, sensor integration or structured capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there a separately observed information retrieval burden beyond the essential physical securing task?

already_counted.description: Physical warning placement and access securing

incremental.description: No added upkeep or transferred work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical actions retain all time; a hypothetical checklist does not earn savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Communicate site restrictions clearly to adjacent site supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A worker who makes physical site restrictions clear and checks actual conditions carefully.
